goal:
T54 — live AI panel + command bar on the evolution screen (v3.8 §2.2 D3 Mission Control; v3.6 CMD-01 RECEIVED !=
APPLIED). Web only; builds on T52 (apps/web/lib/roundReplay.ts, components/RoundReplay.tsx, app/[locale]/replay/page.tsx)
and the T51 API (snapshots carry events [{seq, ts, role: builder|critic|runner|gate, message}]).

1. In apps/web/lib/roundReplay.ts add pure functions (no fetch, no React):
   - agentPanel(run, side) -> exactly four rows in order builder, critic, runner, gate: {role, state, message}. For each
     role take that side's event with the highest seq across all rounds; message = its message; state "active" only
     when run.status === "running" AND that event is the newest event of the side overall; otherwise "done". A role with
     no event: state "idle", message null (never invent activity; the single lane has no Critic).
   - commandState(httpStatus: number | null, runStatus: string | null) -> {state, reason}: null http -> RECEIVED
     (sent, no answer); 409 -> REJECTED "busy"; 402 -> REJECTED "budget"; 422 -> REJECTED "invalid"; any other non-202
     -> REJECTED "error"; 202 with runStatus "running" -> RUNNING, "succeeded" -> APPLIED, "failed" -> FAILED, else
     QUEUED. reason null unless REJECTED.
2. apps/web/lib/api.ts: startEvolutionRun(app_id, feedback) -> POST /v1/evolution/runs returning {status, body}
   (the HTTP status is needed for commandState; do not throw on 402/409/422).
3. apps/web/components/AgentPanel.tsx: shows agentPanel for EvoForge and for the single AI (roles, state dot
   active/done/idle, last message).
4. apps/web/components/CommandBar.tsx: fixed to the bottom of the replay page; app select (from /v1/evolution/apps via
   a new listEvolutionApps() in api.ts), feedback select (critic default, heldout labelled "upper bound"), Start button
   calling startEvolutionRun, the current commandState badge, and a visible warning that starting a run calls the
   model and spends money. After 202, select the new run and let the page poll it.
5. Wire both into apps/web/app/[locale]/replay/page.tsx (AI panel beside the round view, command bar at the bottom).
6. i18n "replay" namespace (en + ko): start, cost-warning, state-received, state-queued, state-running, state-applied,
   state-rejected, state-failed, agents, idle, active, done (plus any labels you add).
Keep tsc green. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t54.py.
